instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Maria. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Maria. Do not return images or details of anyone.

said: I found two registered faces close to "Maria": Maria Santos and Maria Lopez. Which one is your helper? Also, which cameras cover the doors she uses: Front Door (Entrance) and/or Garage Door (Garage entrance)?
reply: Use both the front door and the garage door.

said: Thanks, I will use Front Door and Garage Door. I still need to know which registered face is your helper: Maria Santos or Maria Lopez?
reply: Maria Santos, our cleaner. Maria Lopez is my mother-in-law.

instruction: Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-09 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, Garage Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Maria Santos and limit 500.
